simple.meaning: מִשְׁנֶה (mishneh) appears 35 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Samuel, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 41:43. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as Torah, kingship, priesthood, land, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁנֶה (H4932) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מִשְׁנֶה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מִשְׁנֶה (mishneh) / H4932 is tracked through Genesis 41:43, Genesis 43:12, Genesis 43:15, Exodus 16:5. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H4932. mishneh מִשְׁנֶה noun [masculine] double, copy, second ; — absolute ׳מ Gen 41:43 +; construct מִשְׁנֵה Jer 16:18 3 t., so read also Deut 15:18 (van d. H., > נֶה - Gi), Jer 17:18 (Gie Buhl and others); suffix מִשְׁנֵהוּ 1Sam 8:2 +; plural מִשְׁנִים 1Chr 15:18 ( 1Sam 15:9 ; Ezra 1:10 see below); — 1 (the) double: מ ׳כֶּסֶף Gen 43:12 (J) money of double amount , compare ׳מ כֶּסֶף 43:15 (J), a double amount (in) money (Ges § 131q ); מ ׳לֶחֶם Exod 16:22 (P); ׳וגו אֲשֶׁר׳מ עַל 16:5 (P) the double above what they gathered daily; שָׂכִיר שְׂכַר מִשְׁנֵה Deut 15:18 (see Dr); ׳מ עֲוֺנָם Jer 16:18 the double of their guilt , 17:18 (see above); a double portion Isa 61:7 (twice in verse); Zech 9:12 ; Job 42:10 . 2 written copy of law Deut 17:18 ; Josh 8:32 (D). 3 second in order a. second, rank , הַמּ ׳מִרְכֶּבֶת Gen 41:43 (J), הַמּ ׳רֶכֶב 2Chr 35:24 ; of person one second in rank , priest next to high-priest, ׳(הַ)מ 2Kin 23:4 ; 25:18 = Jer 52:24 ; לְמ ׳אֶהְיֶהלְּֿךָ 1Sam 23:17 , הַמֶּלֶךְ מִשְׁנֵה 2Chr 28:7 , ׳מ לַמֶּלֶךְ Est 10:3 ; 1Chr 15:18 ; 16:5 ; 2Chr 31:12 ; ׳מ מֵאֶחָיו Neh 11:17 . — 1Sam 15:9 read (compare ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ) הַמַּשְׁמַנִּים ( Neh 8:10 ) Th, הַשְּׁמַנִּים or הַשְּׁמֵנִים We Dr Bu, etc. ( Ezek 34:16 ); ׳מִשׁ Ezra 1:10 is apparently corruption of a numeral. b. second in age , 1Sam 8:2 ; 17:13 ; 2Sam 3:3 ; 1Chr 5:12 . 3 second quarter, district , of city, הַמִּשְׁנֶה 2Kin 22:14 2Chr 34:22 ; Zeph 1:10 , compare מִשְׁנֶה הָעִיר Neh 11:9 over the city , namely, the second quarter.
